Diagnostic maturity re-check by Sol curation campaign 2026-10-11 (G27UTY), observed 2026-10-11T08:42:39Z: current Accountable Base, Avalanche and Ethereum rows remain location/value buckets without complete instruments or hard maturity maxima; no reserve allocation or review-date refresh

RS2-018 2026-10-30T11:02Z read: reserves_split returned 13 positive location/custody buckets (USD 13,041,048.05 positive total, dashboard data.ts 2026-10-30T10:46:07.500Z, verifiability 100); the seven sub-cent buckets absent from the reviewed rows (Plasma, Bnb_smartchain, Hyperevm, Arbitrum, Megaeth, Monad, Sei) are carried below, Bybit is absent from the payload

reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-10-30 against the live Accountable reserves_split payload (dashboard data.ts 2026-10-30T10:46:07.500Z, verifiability 100, USD 13,041,048.05 across thirteen positive buckets). The prior 2026-09-01 curation carried six reviewed rows and treated eight sub-0.001% buckets as dust, but the live producer still emits those buckets, so seven captured exposures (Plasma, Bnb_smartchain, Hyperevm, Arbitrum, Megaeth, Monad, Sei) compiled with no admitted asset class and no failure domain; the 2026-09-01 composition also sat outside the 31-day plus 7-day reviewed-composition budget. The composition is now curated from the current raw bucket shares over the positive-bucket total: every bucket is carried, including the seven sub-cent ones, so no captured bucket can compile unstructured, and the weights follow the live book instead of the September split (Base 73.14371777% and Ethereum 8.50765510% now versus 37.9162% and 44.757% on 2026-09-01; Copper, Katana and Hyperliquid remain single-digit dust). Bybit is configured in sourceKeyMap but absent from the payload, so no row is claimed for it. These are location/custody or settlement buckets, not asset classes, so every row stays conservatively classified as assetClass other with the same YieldPoint (XSY) managed-strategy and undisclosed custody/venue-counterparty failure domain, and they remain intentionally unlinked. YieldPoint's flow documentation says USDC is minted 1:1 and swept to a custodian, while XSY's public mechanics describe strategy modules and give long-spot/short-perpetuals only as examples; the sources do not publish the current strategy assets, retained USDC, hedge notionals, margin, venue balances, custody-provider shares, or liquidation buffers. Bucket values are USD from the issuer-hosted Accountable feed; the shares are read as percentages of the positive-bucket total, not of supply.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Accountable reserves_split location/custody snapshot read 2026-10-30T11:02Z (payload timestamp 2026-10-30T10:46:07.500Z), taken as raw bucket shares of the USD 13,041,048.05 positive-bucket total, interpreted with current XSY/YieldPoint flow, strategy, and risk disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The 100% figure reflects that every published Accountable location envelope remains unitemized at asset level and is therefore unresolved for reserve composition; it does not assert that the managed strategy is absent. XSY and Accountable do not itemize the strategy's retained USDC, long/short positions, margin, venue balances, custody-provider allocation, or liquidation buffers within any location bucket.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The source review reopened the cited flow and Accountable surfaces, XSY risks and current YieldPoint terms on 2026-10-20. Current first-party flow docs identify a custodian wallet without naming Ceffu; the unsupported provider attribution is removed, not treated as proof that Ceffu is absent. Copper is expressly mentioned in the OES risk disclosure and appears as a small dashboard location bucket. The issuer claims segregated bankruptcy-remote custody where OES is used but separately acknowledges assets can be held directly at exchanges without OES. Neither source partitions the entire current strategy book by provider/account or supplies the complete governing account agreements. Therefore conditional OES protections cannot establish whole-book segregation or bankruptcy remoteness; both aggregate fields are unknown, while those scoped issuer claims, counterparty risk and the original review start are preserved. Current location buckets are not custody-protection or instrument-maturity proofs.
